scope: Single-node API-accepted steady load; different durability contracts; excludes ramps, HA and long-running production maintenance
aggregation: Median, minimum, maximum and each of three paired 60-second repetitions; no confidence intervals

runner.pairing: Both backends sequentially on each fresh VM, alternating order across three fresh deployment pairs

dataset.other_signals: deployment-envelope dataset; profile units=nanoseconds, unquoted legacy labels, sampleRate=1e9

image_producers.identity_note: The archived config-digest field is Docker inspect Id; this containerd image store reports the OCI manifest identity. oci_config_digest comes from the independently verified archive.

image_equivalence.scope: Reuse pooled-service measurements only: their binaries, the base filesystem and runtime configuration are unchanged. Metrics is remeasured on the fused query-service binary.

source_scope: Metrics uses the fused instant-scan release image from qualified_revision. Pooled-service measurements retain their actual earlier source image and are reused only after checking all filesystem paths and metadata, unchanged binaries, base layer and runtime configuration. Each harness revision is recorded. Diagnostic profiles do not contribute comparison metrics.
